item.title: Rallying Cry – November 8, 2026
item.description: From a historic drop in U.S. homelessness to Pope Leo XIV’s call for peace in Uruguay, today’s headlines remind us that progress—whether in renewable energy talks at COP 31, AI innovation in Mexico, or even digital air traffic control towers—is always within reach.
